review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: It is argued that rewarding students who show improvement is more essential than rewarding learners who show the best academic results in school. Personally, I believe that both these students should be rewarded equally.

Looking first at smart students who have diligently applied themselves to their studies, after exceeding through many challenges to reach their goal, they deserve their praises and privileges. By using this way, it may encourage these students and others to study harder to win against the rewards which can help them propel towards overall academic gains. This kind of competition seen in almost every aspect of life where only the best individuals are rewarded. The students being used to this reality and thrive in the face of fierce competition enable them to gain more experience to achieve success in later life.

Turning to improving learners, they also should be rewarded. In reality, only a few intelligent students can come first and receive the rewards, cause others to think that their bloods, sweats and tears is futile because they can not surpass those outstanding individuals, prone to feeling overwhelmed and disheartened, gradually lose the incentive to study. So they should emphasize their improvements, which encourage them to be diligent in their studies, also help students to understand that they need to constantly improve themselves instead of being irrespective of how well they have been or are performing. The constant desire to outdo themselves every things benefit them more than the competitive determination to win against all others.
review.overall: Cô thấy em đã theo đúng hướng thưởng cả học sinh có thành tích cao và học sinh có tiến bộ. Em có đủ bốn mạch ý chính, đặc biệt là ý về cạnh tranh và việc các em khác dễ nản chí khi chỉ một nhóm được thưởng. Tuy nhiên, bài chưa có kết bài và nhiều câu dài đang thiếu cấu trúc hoàn chỉnh hoặc nối quá nhiều mệnh đề bằng dấu phẩy nên ý đúng chưa rõ. Em cần ưu tiên dựng câu hoàn chỉnh rồi chốt lại lập trường ở kết bài.

paragraphs: Some people believe that schools should reward students who achieve the best academic results, while others argue that it is more important to reward students who make progress. I believe that schools should reward both groups.

On the one hand, students who excel in their studies deserve recognition. Since they have diligently applied themselves to their studies and overcome many challenges to reach their goal, they deserve their praises and privileges. By rewarding these students, schools may encourage them and others to study harder to win rewards, thereby propelling overall academic gains. Moreover, this kind of competition can be seen in almost every aspect of life, where only the best individuals are rewarded. Students who are used to this reality and thrive in the face of fierce competition may gain more experience, which can help them achieve success in later life.

On the other hand, it is equally important to reward students who make progress. In reality, if only a few high-achieving students can come first and receive rewards, other students may think that their efforts are futile because they can not surpass those outstanding individuals. As a result, they may feel overwhelmed and disheartened and gradually lose the incentive to study. Therefore, schools should recognize students' improvements, which can encourage them to be diligent in their studies and also help them understand that they need to improve themselves constantly, irrespective of their current performance. The constant desire to outdo themselves benefits them more than the competitive determination to win against all others.
In conclusion, schools should reward both students who achieve the best academic results and those who make progress.

task.text:
Some people think that school should reward students who show the best academic results, while others believe that it is more important to reward students who show improvements.
Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: There is an opinion that dangerous sports should be banned by governments while others think that people should have freedom to do any sports or activities. Personally, I strongly agree with the latter school of thought, provided that certain conditions are met.

Admittedly, one might argued that dangerous sports should be prohibited because even a minor error can cause directly a death of a participant which can be seen in skydiving. However, prohibition is impossible because most of sports set up in remote locations, say, mountain cliffs which have minimal surveillance and control. Additionally, this is unrealistic for a police officer follows each individual so a prohibition is only existed on paper which can be seen worse than driving practical underground. After all, it is harder to ensure basic safety standards.

On the other hand, people should understand the risk and be permitted to do any type of sports by receiving sufficient training. In deep-ocean diving or bungee jumping, a reputable clubs have to prepare appropriate equipments and qualified supervision. For newbies, they must be accompanied by an expert to taught what to do when accidents occurs, also have abilities to recognise dangers and respond immediately. Also, a proper training and necessary precautions are crucial for safer participation and also to ensure no activity is entirely risk-free.

In conclusion, banning is neither practical nor effective since there are freedom to choose but also participant who is under strict conditions of training and awareness improved their instinct and gain more realistic approaches.

completion.comment: Bài có mở bài, hai thân bài và phần kết trên đủ ảnh đã gán; chỉ kết luận về chữ nhìn thấy.

review.overall: Em có đủ bốn đoạn, giữ được ý ủng hộ tự do có điều kiện và nêu cả nơi xa, chuyên gia, thiết bị. Tuy nhiên, Body 1 còn ráp câu sai ở ‘one might argued’, ‘a police officer follows’ và chuỗi ‘prohibition is only existed on paper’. Body 2 chuyển từ người tham gia sang trách nhiệm câu lạc bộ nhưng chưa giải thích đúng ai phải làm gì; câu kết lại thành ‘participants ... gain more realistic approaches’. Mức vận dụng cấu trúc đã học trong bài này yếu. Em cần viết lại câu chủ đề, cơ chế huấn luyện và kết bài, rồi tự kiểm nghĩa từng câu.

paragraphs: There is an opinion that dangerous sports should be banned by governments, while others think people should have the freedom to do any sport or activity. Personally, I strongly agree with the latter school of thought, provided that certain conditions are met.

Admittedly, one might argue that dangerous sports should be prohibited. This is because even a minor error can directly cause a participant's death, as skydiving shows. However, a ban would be impractical. Most dangerous sports take place in remote locations, such as mountain cliffs, where surveillance and control are limited. Additionally, it is unrealistic to expect a police officer to follow each individual. A prohibition may therefore exist only on paper and may drive the practice underground. When this happens, it becomes harder to ensure basic safety standards.

Instead, people should be permitted to do any sport if they understand the risks and receive sufficient training. For deep-ocean diving or bungee jumping, reputable clubs should provide appropriate equipment and qualified supervision. Beginners should be accompanied by an expert and be taught what to do when accidents occur, enabling them to recognise dangers and respond appropriately. Proper training and precautions make participation safer, although no activity is entirely risk-free.
In conclusion, I think banning dangerous sports is neither practical nor effective. Freedom to choose under strict conditions of training and awareness is a more realistic approach.

review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: There is an opinion that children have the freedom to make mistakes, while others believe that adults should prevent them from causing errors. Personally, I strongly agree that children should learn through trial and error but parents also need to help them avoid mistakes involving serious danger.

Admittedly, as opponents of trial and error often emphasize about the harm of mistakes which are avoidable, such as knives, fire, electricity. These are unnecessary for children to get hurt to learn to be careful. Also, parent's responsibility is shielding childrens from getting injured, so they need to forestall mistakes so they can prevent them from unpredictable situations and even fulfill their duty. Finally, after pre-emptively helping children, adults can have a peace of mind because they do their best to ensure their children's safety and raise them well.

However, those on the other side also have their own valid reasoning. Firstly, adults can not be around their kids all the time so their children may have experiment with new things which help them expand their mind. Secondly, from experience, they may learn some invaluable lessons which can change the way they witness matters and stand children in good stead in later stages in life. Finally, children can be grown independently instead of growing up overdependent on others and has some undesirable traits.

Overall, I am firmly convinced that allowing childrens to learn from mistakes is necessary for preparing for their future, provided that parents still need to intervene and give pre-cautions on serious matters so they can prevent errors which may derail their future.

completion.comment: Ảnh đã đối chiếu cho thấy đủ mở bài, hai thân bài và kết bài; câu cuối khép ý.

review.overall: Em hoàn thành bài, nói rõ ưu tiên học qua sai lầm kèm giới hạn nguy hiểm; mỗi Body nhận ra ba nhánh và ví dụ an toàn cụ thể. Cấu trúc 'Admittedly, as opponents ... emphasize' thiếu mệnh đề chính, 'These' chỉ dao/lửa/điện nhưng lại gán cho chúng việc bị thương, và 'children can be grown independently' sai bị động. Bài còn cẩu thả ở khâu dựng câu, dù dàn ý đã có; em cần viết lại các câu theo chủ thể thật. Mở bài 'I strongly agree' đúng nghĩa và được giữ.

Finally, children can grow up independently rather than become overdependent on others, an undesirable trait that excessive protection may encourage.

Overall, I am firmly convinced that allowing children to learn from mistakes helps prepare them for their future, provided that parents intervene and give guidance on serious matters, thereby helping them prevent errors that may derail their future.

task.text:
WRITING TASK 1
You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.
The graph below shows the three different kinds of emission sources (oil/coal/gas) of greenhouse gas in the UK.
Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
Write at least 150 words.

images.alt: Biểu đồ khí thải từ oil, coal và gas tại Anh, 1990–2010

paragraphs: The given bar chart illustrates different kinds of emission sources of greenhouse gas in the UK.
Overall, each carbon emissions had its own trends with gas, it raised gradually and the opposite is true for coal while only oil’s trend fluctuated the entire period.

To elaborate, the figures for gas and coal were opposite to each other. The amount of gas grew significantly from around 220 to exactly 300 million tons between 1990 and 2000, finally at 2010 it reached approximately 330 million tons, became the highest figure in the entire time. In contrast, coal had a positive trend when it was the fossil fuels having the highest carbon emissions in 1990 but then hardly dropped from 310 to 190 million tons for 20 years.
Regarding the emissions from oil, it fluctuated from 270 to 240 and then recover back to 260 million tons, and the rest of the falls were witnessed from 260 to 210 in 2010.
review.overall: Cô thấy em nhận được ba diễn biến cơ bản, đặc biệt là lần oil tăng lại từ 1995 đến 2000. Em cần thêm giai đoạn 1990–2010 trong mở bài và kiểm tra hai chi tiết quan trọng: gas cuối kỳ khoảng 320, không phải 330; coal giảm mạnh nên không thể gọi là “positive trend” hoặc “hardly dropped”. Em hãy viết câu có chủ ngữ là lượng khí thải và dùng đúng động từ tăng, giảm.

paragraphs.text: The bar chart shows carbon emissions from gas, oil and coal in the United Kingdom between 1990 and 2010. The figures are measured in millions of tons.

Overall, emissions from gas rose and became the highest of the three by 2000, while those from coal declined steadily. Oil fluctuated but ended lower than it began. Coal produced the most emissions at the start of the period, whereas gas led at the end.

To elaborate, emissions from gas and coal followed opposite paths. Gas started at around 220 million tons in 1990 and climbed to about 270 million tons in 1995 and 300 million tons in 2000. Its emissions then increased more slowly, reaching approximately 320 million tons in 2010, the highest figure on the chart. By contrast, coal began at about 310 million tons and fell to 280 million tons in 1995. It continued downward to 250 million tons in 2000, 230 million tons in 2005 and 190 million tons in 2010.

Regarding oil, emissions dropped from approximately 270 million tons in 1990 to 240 million tons in 1995. They recovered to about 260 million tons in 2000 before declining again. The oil figure returned to roughly 240 million tons in 2005 and finished at around 210 million tons in 2010.

task.text:
WRITING TASK 2
You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.
Some people say history is one of the most important school subjects. Other people think that, in today’s world, subjects like science and technology are more important than history. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your knowledge or experience.
Write at least 250 words.

paragraphs: There is an opinion that history is one of the most important school subject while others believe that science and technology are more essential than history. Personally, I have to admit that both play a crucial role in its own sectors.

Looking first at history which was the formed subject in every school helping students to revise about the past. Initially, history make students expand the visions about how our country was established, also it evoke their curiosity making them want to explore more about it, from that helping the lesson more interesting, increasing the bonding between students and teacher. Additionally, more students knowing about history can help the next generations learn and preserve it, also increasing employment opportunities to them in the future and have a stable job in their life.

Turning to science and technology, these subjects also broaden students perspective and are the most innovative sectors nowadays when artificial intelligent are developed rapidly in the world. But nowadays, Firstly, learning these sectors helps they find a stable income profession and also they can help the government improved and strengthen the collaboration between our nation and other countries because of our improvement.

In conclusion, science and technology were essential and crucial in their own sectors. History also helps our society and nation in its own way. Ultimately, ultimately, all subjects are needed in school and really useful in student's future life.
review.overall: Cô thấy em muốn đánh giá cả lịch sử lẫn khoa học, công nghệ, và đã có ý lịch sử giúp thế hệ sau giữ hiểu biết về quá khứ. Để bài thuyết phục hơn, em cần nêu một ví dụ cụ thể cho mỗi môn và giải thích vì sao ví dụ đó chứng minh lợi ích học ở trường. Đoạn khoa học hiện mới nói đến việc làm và hợp tác quốc tế mà chưa chỉ ra kỹ năng học sinh học được. Em cũng nên sửa câu mở thân bài lịch sử thành câu hoàn chỉnh.

paragraphs.text: Some people argue that history deserves the greatest place in school, whereas others give priority to science and technology. I believe all three areas are necessary because they prepare students for different parts of life.

History helps students understand how their community and country developed. A lesson about a past conflict, for example, can show them how earlier decisions affected families and institutions. Students can discuss different accounts of the same event and learn why people remember it in different ways. This may encourage curiosity and careful judgement rather than simple memorisation. Historical knowledge can also be shared with later generations, helping a community preserve its heritage while still examining it critically. These are valuable skills for young people who will eventually take part in civic decisions.

Science and technology offer another set of benefits. Science teaches students to test explanations and work with evidence, while technology helps them apply ideas to practical problems. For instance, pupils could design a small digital tool that helps their class organise a project. Doing so would require planning, testing and cooperation. These skills may support future careers, including work in medicine or engineering. They can also help people use rapidly changing technologies responsibly. A country benefits when students can both understand new tools and question whether a proposed solution actually works.

In conclusion, history provides insight into human experience, while science and technology develop methods for investigating and improving the world. Schools should teach both, giving students opportunities to connect evidence from the past with the challenges they face today.
